subject: general
question: Veer starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 19 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km, takes a right turn and drives 12 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

Veer starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the north. 

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, 

turns right and drives 19 km. 

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km, 

takes a right turn and drives 12 km and stops at Point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98f65f5d0304354669fd5fb180a47dbd42d221054ed4420be2b46c5008c933b7.png] 

So, the distance between A to B is: 8 - 3 = 5 km.

And, Veer should drive **'5 km towards the West'** direction to reach Point A from Point B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
